title: WorldFoundationSchema
description: Schema for world-first campaign initialization and epistemic separation: immutable facts, mutable world state, autonomous factions/tensions, NPC epistemic knowledge maps, subjective rumors/beliefs, and unresolved canon mysteries.

schema_version.description: Semantic versioning of the world foundation specification

overview.description: High-level overview of the world foundation and its autonomous dynamics

immutable_facts.description: Foundational truths of history, geography, natural laws that cannot be rewritten.

mutable_world_state.description: Current dynamic state of factions, resources, control.

active_epoch.description: Current era, season, political climate, or macro timeline state

factions_control.description: Dynamic territorial, jurisdictional, or administrative control mapping

resource_distribution.description: Current availability, scarcity, and supply choke points across the setting

global_tensions_index.description: Aggregate macro tension level across the setting

dynamic_flags.description: World-level boolean or scalar flags tracking emerging geopolitical events

factions_and_tensions.description: Independent faction objectives, active geopolitical / civic tensions.

objectives.description: Independent faction goals that progress autonomously regardless of protagonist intervention

npc_knowledge.description: Map of what specific canon NPCs know, don't know, or falsely believe.

knows.description: Factual truths verified in canon known to this NPC

does_not_know.description: Known unknowns and information this NPC is completely ignorant of

falsely_believes.description: Active misconceptions, biases, or false propaganda accepted as true by this NPC

unresolved_mysteries.description: Canon secrets that must remain unresolved until justified in-world discovery.
